component.name: Folio
component.summary: Offline vector handwriting and notes for Linux

description.p: Write pressure-sensitive notes with a stylus, organize notebooks, annotate PDFs and search titles, tags and typed text. Your original ink stays editable and private.
No account or cloud service is required.
Adds automatic system theme detection with explicit Light and Dark overrides.
User-initiated updates with a title-bar notice, verified downloads, a restart button and a library backup before updating.

Improves large-library saves, fragment restyling, dense canvas queries, thumbnails, text layout and repeated ink rendering. Adds focused settings, clearer folder and document workflows, remembered pen presets and workspace choices, export previews, explicit OCR download controls and stronger recovery. Includes eraser, selection, context-menu and accessibility fixes. Opening an existing library upgrades its database to schema 6; older Folio versions cannot open the upgraded library.

Windows 11 x64 port with a per-user installer, Windows Ink input, native accessibility and portable offline PDF/math tools. Adds configurable notebooks, inline text formatting and continuous page scrolling alongside page organization, notebook sharing, backups, reusable templates and handwriting search.

Initial Folio release: editable vector handwriting, PDF notes, rendered LaTeX and offline step-by-step math. Includes custom window controls and fixes for saving, exports, selections, document validation and large notebooks. The Flatpak includes the CPU math solver and automatic verified OCR downloads, with Vulkan Q8 GPU acceleration and CPU fallback.
